title: Latest official listing check
details: The official Roblox games API shows the public record updated on August 11. The description still supports only the broad crates, toys, friends, workers, and special-codes claims; it does not publish a numbered update, weather-event mechanics, active code string, or gameplay values.

title: Pre-update public check
details: The official Roblox public record was checked before Update 3. The listing changed on July 31, but no Update 3 feature list, active code string, crate values, rebirth effects, or Gamepass effects were published there.

title: MVP evidence baseline created
details: Official identity, a dated public game snapshot, scheduled event information, and public Gamepass price snapshots were recorded. Gameplay-specific values remain gated.
